description: Defines the Metadata class representing a database record for 'thingEntities', including fields for ThingId, revision, policy info, and modification timestamp, with methods for creation and retrieval.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Immutable data class encapsulating metadata for a 'thingEntities' database record, including identifiers, revision info, policy info, and modification timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance with specified ThingId, revision, policy info, without modification timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance with specified ThingId, revision, policy info, and modification timestamp.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Constructs Metadata from an UpdateThingResponse object.

methods.name: getThingRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the Thing.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the PolicyId.

methods.name: getPolicyIdInPersistence
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId as a String for persistence, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getPolicyRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the policy revision number.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the last modification timestamp.

methods.name: getNamespaceInPersistence
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the ThingId for persistence.
